attchmntText: The company had informed the Exchange that the Register of Members & Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from September 12, 2017 to September 22, 2017 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of payment of dividend. The company has now inform the exchange that the Register of Members & Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from September 12, 2017 to September 22, 2017 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of payment of dividend and Annual General Meeting of the Company is scheduled to be held on September 22, 2017.
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Newspaper Advertisements regarding notice of the 70th Annual General Meeting of the Company.'.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Register of Members & Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from September 12, 2017 to September 22, 2017 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of payment of dividend.
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on September 22, 2017
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation
Grasim Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2017.
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

Birla Group Holdings Private Limited has submitted to the Exchange, vide letter dated July 14, 2017 a copy of disclosure under Regulation 10(6) in respect of acquisition under Regulation 10 of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of  2915 Equity Shares under ESOP
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 190462665 securities pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement/Amalgamation at its meeting held on July 09, 2017
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI ( Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 along with a copy of press release regarding a press release dated Jun 10, 2017, titled "Grasim Industries Ltd divests Grasim Bhiwani Textiles Ltd."
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on July 08, 2017.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company intimated the Stock Exchange under Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015 about the updated corporate presentation of Aditya Birla Capital Limited(formerly known as Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited), the subsidiary of the Company.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received an intimation from Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL), informing that ABCL has completed the issuance and allotment of 4,84,00,000 equity shares on a private placement basis to P I Opportunities Fund -1 in accordance with the terms of the Subscription Agreement and the Companies Act, 2013.
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received an intimation from Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) (formerly known as Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited), informing that ABCL has entered into a definitive share subscription agreement (SSA) with PI Opportunities Fund-1. As per the SSA, subject to the customary closing conditions, the Fund will subscribe to about 2.2% of the post scheme fully diluted equity share capital of ABCL. along with a copy of the press release title "Aditya Birla Capital Limited Attracts Investments by Premji Invest; transaction values ABCL at Ra. 32,000 crore."
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received an intimation that Aditya Birla Capital Limited filed its Information Memorandum with the Stock Exchanges.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received an intimation dated June 26, 2017 from Aditya Birla Capital Limited (formerly known as Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited) informing about the appointment of Directors and the Chief Financial Officer by it.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as July 20, 2017 for the purpose of demerger of the financial services business of Grasim to ABCL in terms of Part Ill of the Scheme for determining the entitlement of the equity shareholders of Grasim to receive fully paid up equity shares of ABCL in the ratio of 7 (Seven) fully paid up equity share of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten) each of ABCL credited as fully paid up for every 5 (Five) fully paid up equity shares of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two) each, held by such shareholder in Grasim.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding detailed note on the Scheme between Grasim Industries Limited and Aditya Birla Nuvo limited covering Business and Financial aspects of Scheme including the share entitlement to the shareholders.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Composite Scheme of Arrangement Between Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited ( "ABNL") and Grasim Industries Limited ( "Grasim") and Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited ( "ABFSL") and their respective shareholders and Creditors ("the Scheme").

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited ( ABNL) and Grasim Industries Limited ( Grasim) and Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited ("ABFSL") and their respective shareholders and Creditors ("the Scheme")
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 05, 2017, titled "Press Release issued in connection with approval from the Hon'ble NCLT,Bench at Ahemdabad for the Composite Scheme of Arrangement between the Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited and Grasim Industries Limited and Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited and their respective shareholders and creditors".
Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of  5775 Equity Shares under ESOP

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about the sanctioning of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited and Grasim Industries Limited and Aditya Birla Financial Services Limited and their respective Shareholders and Creditors by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal bench at Ahmedabad. Copy of the Order is awaited.

Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that  the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 19, 2017, recommended Dividend @ Re. 5.50 (Rupees Five and paise fifty only) per equity share of face value Re 2/- each for the year ended March 31, 2017.
Grasim Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2017.
